text: ## PR description ### [Frontend] Add ComfyUI support for r2v (MiniMax H3 as example) [labels: merge-test] ## Purpose Add a Video Reference node for r2v support in ComfyUI r2v: connect reference assets to **Video Reference**, then **Video Reference** to **Generate Video** normal i2v (==first frame to v): renamed "image" input to "frame". "frame" and "reference" inputs are exclusive.
